The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] '''WW-41 CryoBan grenade''' was a type of [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|CryoBan grenade]] which used [[CryoBan/Legends|CryoBan]], a chemical that absorbed heat energy, thus creating at the detonation point an area of intense cold. The CryoBan grenade was an outstanding fire suppressant, and could also be used to destroy electronic components, vehicles, and [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="EGWT" />

[[File:Cryoban_grenade_egwt.png|thumb|left|200px|CryoBan grenade schematics.]]
Life forms exposed to this grenade experienced numbing cold and, unless properly treated immediately with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], may suffer nerve damage or [[Limb/Legends|limb]] loss.<ref name="EGWT" />
